title: The route below the decoy kept Gemma 4 agents off it in both settings
subtitle: Gemma 4 31B and Gemma 4 26B-A4B pooled, 60 runs per row
legend: Route above or below: one line that leads to the correct answer, placed before or after the decoy in the page or message that shows the decoy. A Yes needed the route-above row at or under 25% and the route-below row at or over 75%.
keyDot: share of runs that took the decoy, with 95% interval
keyBars: the two bars a Yes needed (dashed lines)
xLabel: share of runs that took the decoy
